service.method: SELECT GWML.USER_ID AS APP_USER_ID , GWML.LINE_SEQ AS APP_LINE_SEQ , GWML.APP_STAGE , GWML.APP_METHOD , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS APP_USER_NAME , USMT.COMPANY_CODE AS SELLER_CODE , USMT.DEPT , CASE ${session.LANGUAGE} WHEN 'EN' THEN DEPT.DEPT_NAME_ENG ELSE DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC END AS DEPARTMENT_NAME , USMT.POSITION , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , 'EMPLOYEE' AS TYPE FROM SGWML GWML INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON GWML.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND GWML.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND GWML.USER_ID = USMT.USER_ID INNER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.DEPT = DEPT.DEPT WHERE GWML.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND GWML.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND GWML.APP_LINE_CODE = ${APP_LINE_CODE} ORDER BY APP_LINE_SEQ ASC
